program = '''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    sep_values = [grid[r][0] for r in row_seps] + [grid[0][c] for c in col_seps]
    sep = max(set(sep_values), key=sep_values.count)
    row_seps = [r for r in row_seps if grid[r][0] == sep]
    col_seps = [c for c in col_seps if grid[0][c] == sep]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    regions = []
    for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        for j in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            for r in range(row_bounds[i]+1, row_bounds[i+1]):
                for c in range(col_bounds[j]+1, col_bounds[j+1]):
                    regions.append((r,c))
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in regions).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            n = sum(grid[r][c] not in (bg, sep) for r in range(row_bounds[i]+1,row_bounds[i+1]) for c in range(col_bounds[j]+1,col_bounds[j+1]))
            row.append(1 if n == 2 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
